title: Vantage
pitch: The parallax backdrop is the real map — hop into it, shrink to a speck, and cross the valley in a few strides.
howto: Fight giants and crack chests up close, then hop into the backdrop at a vantage shrine to travel the miniature world. Track threats from afar and drop in behind them. Spend embers on upgrades, wake dormant shrines, and seal the Ember Rift to raise the tier.
controls: Move with the arrows, JUMP, STRIKE to fight and activate, HOP at shrines to swap layers. Gamepad: stick, A jump, X strike, B hop.
